items.q: because Ricky and Marjorie Gale at that time had that (?)

ctx.x: Because later on, he more or less said that he wrote these things like...

No, he didn't write... How it happened. One Saturday afternoon, during rehearsal, there was a number, a seasonal number -- I don't remember the name of it. We were taking the last chorus to play for David(?) (?). And we sat there, and I got on the piano, and he did...[SINGS FIRST FEW BARS OF 'STOMPING AT THE SAVOY']. I said, "I like that." I said, "Yeah, but that's too Latin," you know, because Ricky and Marjorie Gale at that time had that (?), [SINGS...] Yeah, I liked that. So I just couldn't understand it. In…
